capabilities_done: kernel-bindings src/ckc.rs: CkcCatalogPort trait (get, search, mutate_metadata, keyword, collection, request_xmp_sidecar) and typed requests: AssetId/CollectionId (ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._:-], <= 128), Rating Unrated|Stars 1..5, Flag Flagged|Unflagged|Rejected, ColorLabel Red|Yellow|Green|Blue|Purple, KeywordPath (root-first, no |), MetadataMutation (idempotent request_id, expected_revision, SetRating/SetFlag/SetLabel/AddKeyword/RemoveKeyword), KeywordCommand::DefineSynonyms, CollectionCommand (Create manual|set, CreateSmart, AddMembers, RemoveMembers, SetRule, Delete), SearchRequest (CatalogRule All/Any/NoneOf/Match, sort keys, offset/limit), XmpSidecarWrite (CKC writes the bytes; BesideOriginal | CatalogArtifactOnly), CkcReceipt with operator/model actor attribution; every request validates ids, text/control chars, counts, rule depth and node count by explicit stack, op/field/value compatibility and range operands (test port_requests_are_validated_and_bounded)

kernel-bindings src/ckc_double.rs: CkcTestDouble compiled only under cfg(test) or the non-default ckc-test-double feature (compile_fail doctest CKC_DOUBLE_IS_NOT_SHIPPED proves it is absent from default builds); enforces expected revision, idempotent replay, per-call denial without existence leak, set-only parents, parent cycles, non-empty set delete (test double_enforces_revision_idempotency_authorization_and_parents); its search semantics are its own, not CKC's

lrcat develop_map: Exposure2012/Contrast2012/Highlights2012/Shadows2012/Whites2012/Blacks2012/Vibrance/Saturation/Clarity2012 and Custom Temperature/Tint (checked by develop white_xy) map into develop BasicTone, Presence, AbsoluteWhiteBalance and exposure stops; out-of-range, non-number, preset WB and unknown keys are typed losses; mapped rows carry develop_scale_unverified (test develop_settings_and_zlib_xmp_map_typed)

lrcat XMP inflate: bare or 4-byte-length-prefixed zlib values inflate through hsk-studio-package inflate_exact (single shared DEFLATE, D16) capped at XmpLimits.max_input_bytes before output; zlib header, preset dictionary, Adler-32 and declared length checked; refusals xmp_inflate_over_limit (8 MiB bomb), xmp_zlib_checksum, xmp_inflate_length_mismatch, xmp_inflate_failed (same test)

lrcat ckc_import: plan_ckc_import(LibraryProposal, resolver, CkcLimits) -> CkcImportPlan (synonyms; collections parents first, non-set parents dropped as collection_parent_dropped, smart collections created only when the whole rule translates else smart_rule_not_translatable; manual membership; per-asset rating/flag/label/keyword mutations, custom labels label_not_in_ckc_set; deterministic request ids from the source fingerprint) and apply_ckc_import(port, actor, plan) with expected revision read per asset; re-apply replays identical receipts; a denied principal fails (test library_proposal_imports_through_ckc_port_double, two fixtures, against the double)

spec_basis: STU-ASSET-001: CKC is the single asset library, media catalog and file manager; Studio MUST NOT acquire one

STU-ASSET-004: no second metadata, keyword, rating, label or flag store and no second collection or smart-collection mechanism; 'Standalone reusable assets MUST consume artifact/catalog bytes through injected typed provider ports'
STU-ASSET-010: Studio MUST reach CKC through typed commands (asset.search, asset.get, ...), never through direct filesystem access or a private index

STU-ASSET-019 + Spec 10.10.4.5: Keyword Tagging (hierarchical), Star Ratings 0-5, Color Labels Red/Yellow/Green/Blue/Purple, Pick/Reject Flags Flagged/Unflagged/Rejected, Collections, Smart Collections (rule-based), Metadata Read/Write EXIF/IPTC/XMP
STU-ASSET-021: every cross-module asset read and write passes the ResourceBroker; a denied read is unauthorized and receipted
STU-ASSET-022: model lanes have the same commands, attributed by actor
STU-ASSET-023: mutating the CKC asset record (retag, rate, move, delete) uses the expected-revision precondition at asset granularity
STU-AUT-127: catalog_query (a CKC search expression per STU-ASSET-010) is how a smart collection becomes a batch input
